title: Status line counting new replies
where: Top bar, right side, on every screen while any reply is unread
why_cut: The Inbox tab's blue dot already says there is unread news, and each thread in the list carries its own unread mark, so the line restates what two surfaces show.
cost: The exact count at a glance; the top bar's right side would hold only the avatar.

title: Bot tab when nothing waits on the bot
where: Queue tabs above the card list
why_cut: A tab that opens an empty list offers nothing; the bot's work shows up in All when it exists.
cost: The tabs would change between days, moving All under the pointer when the bot gets work; agents lose the explicit 'nothing on the bot' confirmation.

title: Kind word over each card
why_cut: The card's title and its buttons already say what it is: a question has answer buttons, a to-do has Done.
cost: In a mixed list, a word telling questions from to-dos before reading the title; it repeats on every card in a list of one kind.

title: Age on every message
why_cut: Consecutive messages of the same age repeat it; only a change in age tells the reader anything.
cost: Scanning to one message no longer gives its age without looking up; a quieter option is showing an age only where it differs from the message above.
